summary: Toyota site cards (36 lines, 489 trims) were largely accurate. Fixed 3 ended generations that had no end year (Aygo II to 2022, Corolla Verso II to 2009, Land Cruiser J80 to 1997), added the 2007 Corolla Verso facelift and the iQ code AJ10. Proposed 25 line fixes, 12 removals and 7 missing lines (Avensis Verso, Yaris Verso, GR Yaris, Corolla Cross, Hiace, C-HR+, Land Cruiser FJ).
